title: A guard against empty pages silently became a minimum conversation length
symptom: Trimming cut a 695-character share to 315, below the shell-detection threshold, so the entry was marked failed and nothing was stored.
root_cause: Three thresholds written to distinguish a rendered page from an empty shell each also acted as a minimum content length.
correction_made: Thresholds keyed on how the text was obtained rather than on its length; untrimmed fallback; acceptance from 60 characters for a browser capture.
